papers.title_en: Cognitively Decoupled Meta-Induction for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
papers.authors: Yuqian Wang, Yuanzheng Wang, Chaojun Xiao, Ke Xu, Bingxiang He, Jinghan Tan, Zijun Chen, Lu Chen, Yi-Xin Huo, Maosong Sun
papers.evidence: 用于上下文学习的双回路元归纳学习
papers.tldr: 上下文学习主要依赖查询与示例的邻近匹配，限制了分布外（OOD）泛化能力。为此，本文提出了认知解耦元归纳（CoDI）方法，通过提取任务级归纳表示并结合元学习优化归纳器，实现了跨任务的高效归纳推理，在多个基准测试中显著提升了泛化性能。
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) tackles downstream tasks conditioned on demonstrations. This paradigm relies heavily on neighbor-based matching between queries and demonstrations, limiting out-of-distribution (OOD) performance. For better generalization, rule-based inductive reasoning derives task-level regularities, which we term task-level inductive representations (TIR), before directly answering. However, existing methods lack generalizable inductive ability across diverse tasks. Inspired by meta-learning, we propose Cognitive-Decoupling meta-Induction (CoDI) for TIR-based inductive reasoning on general tasks. CoDI comprises a Cognitive-Decoupling Framework for query-blind TIR induction, and a Dual-Loop Meta-Inductive Learning method for cross-task inducer optimization. Empirically, CoDI achieves substantial performance gains on five ID and OOD benchmarks, and preserves OOD gains without explicit induction at inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Yuqian-Wang2277/codi-meta-induction.

papers.title_en: MuPACE: Learning to Pace Muon for LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Jan Kobiolka, Christian Frey, Josif Grabocka
papers.evidence: 在微调问题中元学习全局步长
papers.tldr: 本文针对大模型LoRA微调中学习率策略难以适应动态训练过程的问题，提出了MuPACE方法。该方法通过一个小型循环策略元学习Muon优化器的全局步长，在不改变优化器方向的前提下动态调整学习率。实验表明，MuPACE不仅在多数微调任务上优于固定策略，还能零样本迁移至更深的模型，展现出极强的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Learning rate schedules are typically fixed before training begins, yet when fine-tuning large language models with low-rank adapters (LoRA), the appropriate scale varies substantially with the model, task, and adapter configuration. Practitioners re-tune a schedule for every new problem, yet a tuned schedule still cannot react to the training dynamics it encounters. We instead amortize learning rate selection across LoRA fine-tuning problems. We leave the base optimizer, Muon, untouched, so that its normalized update fixes the direction, and meta-learn only the global step size. Our method MuPACE is a small recurrent policy, meta-trained across a distribution of fine-tuning runs, that conditions on the observed trajectory and emits bounded adjustments to an interpretable analytic schedule. On 64 fine-tuning problems, MuPACE outperforms standard fixed schedules at a strong shared default on 64-78% of problems and is on par with the same schedules with per-task tuned peaks. Meta-trained only on models with up to 16 layers, MuPACE transfers one-shot to unseen tasks on models as deep as 64 layers, such as Qwen3-32B and Qwen3.8-27B, where a single run remains competitive with swept schedules.

papers.title_en: How Prompt Style Affects AI Accuracy and Speed in Competitive Programming
papers.authors: Saad B. Alarifi, Mohammed A. Alam
papers.evidence: 比较提示策略的准确性和速度
papers.tldr: 本研究探讨了大语言模型在竞技编程中提示词风格对准确率和运行速度的影响。通过在IOI任务和NP-hard速度任务上测试GPT-5.5的9种提示词风格，并与人类选手进行对比，发现没有单一的提示词在所有任务上都表现最优，其效果取决于任务类型和评估指标。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used in competitive programming, and their outputs are sensitive to how a prompt is phrased. Prior work has compared prompt strategies for accuracy on competitive programming, but not for runtime speed, and has not situated the results against human performance. In an exploratory study of one prompt in each of nine styles on GPT-5.5 across three accuracy tasks from the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) and two NP-hard speed tasks, we found that no single prompt was best: the strongest prompt depended on the task type and on whether results were summarized by the mean or the median, suggesting that, at least for these tasks, prompt style should be matched to the objective rather than treated as universal. Many differences in mean scores came from a few outlier runs, showing that evaluating prompting by a single metric can obscure how much its effectiveness varies. Compared descriptively with human IOI contestants, who worked under different conditions, the AI was neither strictly better nor strictly worse, exceeding the average contestant on one task but falling short on the other two. By extending prompt comparison from accuracy to runtime speed and grounding it against human performance, this study gives a broader picture of how prompt style affects competitive programming performance.

papers.title_en: CVaR-RMD: CVaR Selection Pressure for Robust Metaheuristic Discovery
papers.evidence: 使用LLM变异启发式程序进行自动化算法设计
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CVaR-RMD的风险敏感型演化框架，利用大语言模型通过迭代程序搜索来自动发现稳健的启发式算法。针对传统基于平均性能的目标容易掩盖严重失败的问题，该方法引入经验条件风险价值（CVaR）作为选择压力，显著提升了算法在异构评估条件下的上尾性能并降低了失败率。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have recently been used to discover heuristics through iterative program search, offering a promising approach to automated algorithm design. However, candidates selected by average performance may degrade across instance families, random seeds, and problem scales because mean-based objectives can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose CVaR-RMD, a risk-sensitive evolutionary framework that uses an LLM to mutate executable heuristic programs and ranks candidates by empirical conditional value-at-risk over heterogeneous evaluation conditions. Across three combinatorial optimization domains, CVaR-based selection improves upper-tail performance and reduces failure rates while maintaining competitive mean performance. These gains persist on larger unseen instances and independently curated within-domain benchmarks

papers.title_en: Privacy-preserving inference on hosted models: a learned input-embedding transform for frozen Qwen3.8-27B
papers.evidence: 针对冻结大语言模型的学习输入嵌入转换
papers.tldr: 本文研究了托管大语言模型的隐私保护推理问题，提出在客户端将文本转换为向量并利用小型训练网络进行变换后再发送给主机，从而在主机不接触原始文本或token ID的情况下，实现对冻结的Qwen3.8-27B模型的隐私安全调用，且仅损失少量准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Every prompt sent to a hosted language model is readable by whoever runs it. We study whether the prompt can remain on the client while the host receives transformed vectors that stand in for it. A language model converts text to vectors exactly once, with a public lookup table; we perform that step locally and pass the vectors through a small trained network (55.6M parameters) before they leave the perimeter. The host runs a frozen 27B model (Qwen3.8-27B) on the transformed vectors and never receives text or token ids. We train the transform against the frozen model as a fixed judge, combining a forward-KL utility term with an auxiliary term that pushes each vector away from its original direction. On 1,490 MMLU questions held out from training, the transform costs 1.5 points of accuracy (80.7% vs. 82.3%), breaking 68 of the 1,226 questions the unmodified model answers correctly (5.5%), while 30.1% of content tokens no longer decode to their original token under a nearest-neighbour lookup.

papers.title_en: IRAH: Hierarchical Agentic Tree Search for Retrieval Pipeline Optimization
papers.authors: Maria Ana Cardei, Aniket Singh, Amir Moghadam, Srividhya Baikadi, Rashmi Shetty
papers.evidence: 数值超参数和结构组件的分层搜索
papers.tldr: 本文介绍了信息检索智能体框架（IRAH），用于解决检索增强生成（RAG）中优化检索管道结构和超参数的难题。IRAH将基于UCT的语言智能体树搜索（LATS-IR）与离线元学习初始化相结合，在有限的评估预算下实现了宏观结构探索与数值参数优化的有机结合。实验表明，IRAH在多个基准测试中展现出优异的性能和泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing Information Retrieval (IR) pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) requires jointly selecting structural components and numerical hyperparameters under limited evaluation budgets. We introduce the Information Retrieval Agentic Harness (IRAH), which combines Language Agent Tree Search for IR (LATS-IR) with offline meta-learned initialization. LATS-IR performs UCT-guided hierarchical search, first exploring macro-structural pipeline choices and then refining numerical parameters, with natural-language reflections to guide subsequent mutations and provide inspectable search traces. We evaluate IRAH on three in-distribution benchmarks and one out of-distribution benchmark to assess generalization under distribution shift. Under the same meta-learned initialization, LATS-IR outperforms TPE on two of three in-distribution benchmarks, with gains of up to 6.4%, and remains competitive on the out-of-distribution benchmark. Across all four benchmarks, warm-started IRAH achieves the highest average held-out nDCG@10 (0.4816) and improves over its cold-start counterpart. These results establish IRAH as a competitive approach to retrieval pipeline optimization under constrained evaluation budgets.
